The CSLR, established after the banking royal commission, is currently short $170m as the number of claims from collapsed firms like Dixon Advisory far exceeds initial projections.

The Bright Side:
The shortfall is forcing a necessary conversation about redesigning the scheme to ensure it remains sustainable and focused on actual losses rather than hypothetical gains.
